$comment: ARC-03: tables in module schemas without household_id (no data of a space), each with the reason. Checked by scripts/check-schema.ts; a table of a space's data never goes here. Accounts and sign-in data of persons (identity) are not data of a space: a login exists before its first space (ADR-0009).

tables.audit.platform_entries: Platform audit log (П-10) for changes that belong to no household: feature flag rollouts and module kill switches (CICD-06). Opaque staff ids, flag keys, module names and setting values; no customer data.
tables.feature_flags.flags: Rollout state of each feature flag (CICD-06): platform-wide setting (stage, share in %), no customer data. Test spaces are in feature_flags.test_households under the household policy.
tables.feature_flags.kill_switches: Kill switch of each module (CICD-06 FR 3): platform-wide setting (module name, on/off), no customer data.
tables.identity.accounts: Account data of a person, not of a space (ADR-0009): a login exists before its first space and may later belong to several, so it has no household_id; only the identity module's role reaches it, and no space's data is in it. Email, display name and the argon2id hash of the password.
tables.identity.email_confirmations: Account data of a person, not of a space (ADR-0009): a login exists before its first space and may later belong to several, so it has no household_id; only the identity module's role reaches it, and no space's data is in it. SHA-256 digests of email confirmation links, their expiry and use.
tables.identity.registrations: Account data of a person, not of a space (ADR-0009): a login exists before its first space and may later belong to several, so it has no household_id; only the identity module's role reaches it, and no space's data is in it. SHA-256 digests of the opaque token of a sign-up's «Перевірте пошту» screen.
tables.identity.sessions: Account data of a person, not of a space (ADR-0009): a login exists before its first space and may later belong to several, so it has no household_id; only the identity module's role reaches it, and no space's data is in it. SHA-256 digests of session tokens, their start, last use and end.
tables.identity.sign_in_guards: Sign-in lockout per typed email (ACC-01, NFR-14 FR 7, ADR-0009), also for addresses without an account, so it cannot belong to a space: a SHA-256 digest of the address, the lock end and the CAPTCHA mark.
tables.identity.throttle_events: Timed events of the sign-in and mail limits (ACC-01, ADR-0009) before any space exists: a SHA-256 digest of the address, the limit and the time.
tables.identity.rate_limit_windows: NFR-14 limiter counters that survive restarts (sign-ups per client address, ACC-01): a SHA-256 digest of the address, the window and the count; no space's data.
